summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The BBH Select Large Cap ETF (BBHL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund seeks long-term capital growth by actively managing a narrow portfolio of large-cap companies worldwide. Security selection is based on fundamental business analysis. BBHL was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by BBH.

holdings.infoBox: BBHL is an equity ETF with a total of 49 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 8.05%, Alphabet at 6.37%, Apple at 5.47%, Amazon.com at 5.32%, and Mastercard at 4.18%.
